summary: @servicetitan/microfront-tests preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js`, a ~727KB Bun-compiled, heavily obfuscated bundle shipped inside the tarball. Both `setup.mjs` (hex-named identifiers, dictionary-based string indirection hiding `child_process`, `https`, and `fs` usage) and `math_init.js` (Bun-compiled bundle with ~1000-entry mixed number/string dictionary and generated identifier names) are obfuscated to resist inspection. The package presents itself as a thin re-export of `ts-mockito` test helpers, which has no need for a downloaded alternate runtime or a large opaque native-runtime bundle. The alternate-runtime download + execution of an opaque, purpose-mismatched, obfuscated payload fires automatically on `npm install`, granting the publisher arbitrary code execution on any host that installs the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
